title: Graph Data Ingestion Schema
description: Minimal schema for ingesting entities and relationships into Memgraph. Designed for maximum flexibility - users control display format, naming conventions, and content structure.

dataset_id.description: Unique identifier for this dataset (used for deduplication and bulk operations)

created_at.description: Timestamp when the dataset was created (ISO 8601)

entities.description: Graph nodes to ingest. Each entity must have a name. All other fields are optional.

id.description: Unique entity ID (auto-generated if not provided)

name.description: Human-readable name of the entity (required, used for deduplication if no ID)

labels.description: Labels to apply to the graph node

relationships.description: Graph relationships between entities. Each relationship requires source, target, and type.

category.description: Relationship category for verb inference and visualization. One of: CAUSAL, HIERARCHICAL, COMPOSITIONAL, CONTEXTUAL, ATTRIBUTIVE, SEQUENTIAL, COMPARATIVE, ANALOGICAL. Auto-inferred from relationship type if not provided.
